verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.smooth.sh/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index of the docs. Every docs page is also served as a raw .md file, which gives an agent ready-to-ingest documentation. One community comment says the docs pages aren't very token-efficient, but that is a quality critique, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar consolidated agent bundle, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths return 404), and no independent hands-on report of an agent consuming the llms.txt.
